## Checklist

- [ ] Tested on a **physical device** (say which, and if you couldn't test one platform)
- [ ] Both platforms, or documented as one-platform-pending
- [ ] Public API changes include a `guides/reference/` update in this PR
- [ ] New props / events / conditions have a control in `example/`
- [ ] No domain logic added to the library (see [design principles](../docs/README.md#design-principles))
- [ ] None of the [eight rules](../docs/README.md#the-eight-rules) broken
